description: Get details about one server: name, description, member/channel/role counts, boost tier, owner, and creation date. The owner field is a user ID. roleCount includes the @everyone role. channelCount also counts the threads in the bot's cache. With DISCORD_GUILD_MEMBERS=false, memberCount is not updated after the bot connects. Use discord_get_server_stats for a finer breakdown (humans vs bots, channel types).
name: discord_get_guild_info
